title: Canton Tokenization Readiness Diagnostic
description: 12-question diagnostic across six weighted domains. Score your firm's readiness for a Canton Network pilot before committing resources.

mcp_tool_definition.name: diagnose_canton_readiness
mcp_tool_definition.description: Score firm readiness for Canton Network tokenization pilot across six domains: settlement ops, custody, cash-leg, privacy, AML/KYA, capital governance. Returns total score (0-100), grade (A-F), domain breakdown, gaps, and routing recommendations.

q1.description: Has your ops team tested atomic DvP/PvP settlement end-to-end?

q2.description: Do you have a settlement-failure / unwind procedure defined?

q3.description: Are your target assets DTC-eligible or Fed-eligible?

q4.description: Have you mapped tokenized assets to HQLA tiers?

q5.description: Have you identified a regulated cash-leg provider (USDC, deposit token)?

q6.description: Has your cash-leg provider completed a reserve attestation?

q7.description: Have you configured Daml party visibility / sub-transaction privacy?

q8.description: Does your privacy config satisfy AML / audit disclosure obligations?

q9.description: Have you completed counterparty KYA for Canton onboarding?

q10.description: Have you screened all parties against FATF Travel Rule requirements?

q11.description: Have you assessed SCO60 Group 1a treatment for your tokenized assets?

q12.description: Have you engaged your prudential regulator on the Canton pilot?
